scope: Additive correction to early-Punt continuation wording only. Prior v22 receipts and observations are preserved. Historical v17 blanket first-Punt/nonreturn conclusion remains superseded research, not admission authority.

source_control.first_callback: Punt sets g_54F8=1, formats and prints the fatal text, then calls g_9128(0,15,0). Before IBMInitStuff reaches f_205F_0004, the admitted zero-startup callback-table owner has not been reset by f_1B4E_0025; g_9128 therefore has a source-zero far target.
source_control.ordinary_far_return: An ABI-correct far return from g_9128 resumes at the next source statement, f_1CE2_01C3. It does not by itself return the first Punt to the database caller or bypass the fatal continuation.
source_control.text_continuation: f_1CE2_01C3 formats nonempty text and calls f_24AB_038D. Source-initialized fd_55B3_65A4=0 selects f_1FBD_0000 raster fallback. Before display setup, g_3DD6, g_3DDA, g_3DDC start at zero and g_3DDE starts at eight; display-driver setup has not run on the early database-failure path.
source_control.second_callback: The fallback reaches g_9154: directly at f_1B4E_005E in the regular raster path, or per character through f_1B4E_0081 and f_1B4E_0110 for g_5A97==6. g_9154 is slot 11, byte offset 0x2c from g_9128, and is also zero before f_1B4E_0025 resets the table. Its zero-target execution has no established semantic/stack/state contract.
source_control.conditional_termination: If both invalid indirect calls and all intervening helpers return with their ordinary ABI/control-state behavior, source reaches o15_384C_0152. Every g_2BD4 switch case falls through to unconditional C exit(0); case selection changes cleanup before exit, not the terminal path.
source_control.unresolved_boundary: No contract or execution observation establishes the effects of either 0000:0000 code execution or proves state/stack preservation through the pre-display rendering path. No actual early-Punt return to startup, counterexample, or arbitrary corruption is claimed. No physical IVT bytes were read.
separation: The bounded fifth-sound-open argument still requires all four predecessor DB opens to return successfully and no earlier first Punt.
Post-init /s9 layout remains a separate issue.
The timer restore's real pre-init effects remain as documented in the pinned v22 receipt; they are not altered by this addendum.
